title: Plain documentation needs no specialist review
description: A non-sensitive docs-only change must not trigger security or trading-safety routing.

title: Workflow change requires security review
description: Any change under .github/ must require security review because it can alter automation and permissions.
safetyInvariant: Changes to .github/ automation always route to security review.

title: Admin API route requires security review
description: Admin-authenticated API routes are security-sensitive and must require security review.
safetyInvariant: Admin/auth API routes always route to security review.

title: Auth library change requires security review
description: Libraries implementing auth/CSRF/secure-compare are security-sensitive and must require security review.
safetyInvariant: Auth/CSRF/secure-compare libraries always route to security review.

title: Trading policy change requires trading-safety review
description: Changes to the deterministic trade policy must require trading-safety review.
safetyInvariant: src/trading/** always routes to trading-safety review.

title: Guardrail change requires trading-safety review
description: Changes to guardrail modules (e.g. the drawdown lock) must require trading-safety review.
safetyInvariant: src/guardrails/** always routes to trading-safety review.

title: Database migration requires trading-safety review
description: Drizzle/Supabase migrations touch persistent trading state and must require trading-safety review.
safetyInvariant: drizzle/ and supabase/migrations/ always route to trading-safety review.

title: Governance change requires both specialist reviews
description: The canonical governance spec controls live-trading and authority boundaries, so it requires both trading-safety and security review.
safetyInvariant: The governance spec always routes to both security and trading-safety review.

title: Cross-cutting change requires both specialist reviews
description: A change touching both an auth library and the trade policy must require both security and trading-safety review.
safetyInvariant: A PR that touches both a security-sensitive and a trading-sensitive path routes to both specialists.

title: Neutral library and UI changes need no specialist review
description: Non-sensitive library and UI files must not trigger either specialist route.

title: Trading-adjacent file outside protected paths is not routed
description: A file with a trading-adjacent name but outside src/trading/** must not be routed to trading-safety; routing is path-based, not name-based.

title: Crafted filename cannot suppress required routing
description: A companion docs file whose name attempts to instruct reviewers to skip review must not prevent the trade-policy change from routing to trading-safety.
safetyInvariant: Routing is derived from deterministic path rules; adversarial filenames cannot suppress a required specialist route.

title: Multiple trading files still require one trading-safety route
description: Several changed files under trading paths must resolve to the trading-safety route without dropping it.
safetyInvariant: Any trading-sensitive file in a changeset requires trading-safety review.

title: Docs under a trading-named folder are not code-routed
description: Documentation under a trading-named docs folder is not source code and must not trigger a specialist code review route.
